description: This file implements server-side chat event handling, including session management, heartbeat processing, chat delta streaming, and event broadcasting for a chat application. It manages chat sessions, tool events, and lifecycle events, and interacts with various external modules for configuration, logging, and session state.

methods.name: resolveHeartbeatAckMaxChars
methods.description: Determines the maximum number of acknowledgment characters for heartbeat messages, loading configuration with fallback to default.

methods.name: resolveHeartbeatContext
methods.description: Resolves the appropriate heartbeat context based on run IDs, prioritizing heartbeat status.

methods.name: shouldHideHeartbeatChatOutput
methods.description: Decides whether to hide heartbeat acknowledgment/noise from chat surfaces based on configuration and visibility settings.

methods.name: normalizeHeartbeatChatFinalText
methods.description: Normalizes the final chat text for heartbeat messages, stripping tokens if necessary and determining suppression.

methods.name: isSilentReplyLeadFragment
methods.description: Checks if a given text is a silent reply lead fragment based on token patterns.

methods.name: appendUniqueSuffix
methods.description: Appends a suffix to a base string, avoiding overlaps with existing suffixes.

methods.name: resolveMergedAssistantText
methods.description: Merges previous and next assistant texts, considering delta suffixes and overlaps.

methods.name: createChatRunRegistry
methods.description: Creates a registry for managing chat run entries, supporting add, peek, shift, remove, and clear operations.

methods.name: createChatRunState
methods.description: Creates and manages the state of chat runs, including buffers, delta tracking, and aborted runs.

methods.name: createSessionEventSubscriberRegistry
methods.description: Creates a registry for session event subscribers, managing connection IDs.

methods.name: createSessionMessageSubscriberRegistry
methods.description: Creates a registry for session message subscribers, managing connection IDs per session.

methods.name: createToolEventRecipientRegistry
methods.description: Creates a registry for tool event recipients, managing connection IDs per run ID with pruning based on TTL.

methods.name: createAgentEventHandler
methods.description: Constructs an event handler for agent events, managing session snapshots, chat delta streaming, and lifecycle events, with broadcasting and session management.
